subject: Acme POC: confirm hands-on workshop timing, agenda & pre-reads

Subject: Acme POC: confirm hands-on workshop timing, agenda & pre-reads

Hi Sara —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our call I wanted to lock in a hands-on kickoff so your team can run through prompt review, routing validation, and a light load verification. Proposed slot: Thursday Jan 21, 10:00–13:00 PT. We expect 3 hours: 45m orientation + 2h working lab (prompt and routing) + 15m wrap.

Pre-reads I plan to share: a short agenda, the prompt test matrix, and the load test runbook. Can you please confirm: 1) that the proposed slot works for Michael and Ops, and 2) whether you want the session recorded?

I've attached an initial agenda and the prompt matrix so your engineers can scan ahead.

Thanks — Hannah

--
Hannah Schmitt
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0142

Subject: Re: Acme POC: confirm hands-on workshop timing, agenda & pre-reads

Hi Hannah —

Thanks for putting this together. Quick note: Michael is out the week of Jan 18 (travel), so Jan 21 conflicts. Ops is available that day but would prefer the session be in the afternoon PST. Could we look at Thu Jan 28, 12:00–15:00 PT instead? Recording is fine.

Also, can you add a short section in the agenda on our routing rules (we have a fallback priority for low-latency queries) — Mike will want to see how Redwood handles the tiering.

Appreciate it,
Sara

Subject: Re: Acme POC: confirm hands-on workshop timing, agenda & pre-reads

Great — thanks for the heads up. Thu Jan 28, 12:00–15:00 PT works for our team. We'll add a 20m routing deep-dive into the middle of the lab and call out the fallback/priority controls.

Dev — can you own the routing demo and a short KV-cache/latency example? Ben — can you prepare the load test steps and bring the Runbook so we can do a 10–15m smoke run (target: 50 concurrent lightweight requests) during the lab?

I'll update the agenda and re-share attachments + send an ics. Also adding Marissa to help with calendar & materials distribution.

Cheers,
Hannah

--
Hannah Schmitt
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 13 Jan 2027 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Acme POC: confirm hands-on workshop timing, agenda & pre-reads

Adding notes from my side —

- I will own the routing demo. Plan: show topology-based routing (region -> low-latency), then fallback to quantized variant. Short live prompt: route same prompt to both and compare tail latency and token cost.
- For the KV-cache example I need a small dataset; attaching sample prompt set and index token file.
- For the smoke load: Ben, can you confirm the script and the endpoint URL? I will coordinate the infra (temporary extra worker) for the 50 concurrent run so we don't affect other customers.

Also see the updated agenda link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1XqAcmePOCShared (permissions set to Acme + Redwood).

Thanks — Dev

--
Dev Patel
Principal Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Sara Lopez <sara@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Michael Turner <mturner@acme-analytics.com>
Date: Wed, 13 Jan 2027 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Acme POC: confirm hands-on workshop timing, agenda & pre-reads

Hi all —

Load test plan (short):
- Target: 50 concurrent lightweight requests (512 tokens avg) for 10 minutes
- Script: locust-based script stored in the shared drive (LoadTest_Runbook.md)
- Safe guard: sandboxed worker pool + throttling rule to abort at >70 RPS
- Metrics we'll capture: p50/p90/p99 latency, tokens/sec, error rate, and cost estimate by token group

I will attach the runbook and a small test payload file. Sara — if you want specific prompts in the matrix tested, drop them into the Prompt_Test_Cases.xlsx by Thursday and I'll bake them into the script.

I'll send the calendar invite once Hannah confirms the final agenda.

Thanks — Ben

--
Ben Carter
SRE, Redwood Inference

2) Please confirm the expected resource consumption estimate for the smoke run (so I can pre-approve capacity).

Marissa — once Hannah sends the ics we can finalize attendee list.

Look forward to it.

Michael
